message: Hi, I'm a student with a distro making certification background. My overall academic average is 79% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in cloud computing and cloud computing. I want to become a Web Developer. My family can afford at most about USD 3500 per year. I live in Bengaluru. I'm open to anywhere in India. Getting a good job after graduation matters more to me than anything else.
explanation:
This program is located in Bengaluru and has a high placement rate (95%) with an affordable tuition fee ($3500), making it ideal for your location preference and job security focus. While focused on QA testing, the software engineering field aligns well with your goal of becoming a Web Developer.

This MTech program in Pune offers 'networking_cloud' and 'software_engineering,' directly addressing your interest in cloud computing and web development. The tuition ($2050) is well within budget, and the curriculum provides relevant technical skills for job placement.

Located in Hyderabad, this MBA program focuses on IT Management. It has a very low tuition cost ($1900) and a decent starting salary potential, offering a management perspective that can complement your technical skills while staying within budget.

This program in Coimbatore offers 'software_engineering' and HCI, which is relevant for web development. The tuition ($2250) is affordable, and the focus on software engineering provides a strong technical foundation while meeting your budget constraints.

This MTech program in Chennai covers 'data_science_analytics' and 'business_information_systems,' which are adjacent to cloud computing. With a moderate tuition fee ($3250) and being open to locations outside Bengaluru, it provides valuable technical exposure.
